cues: Fourth, adiabatic: no heat flow at all.
Wrap the cylinder in thick insulation and let it expand.
The gas does work, but no heat comes in to pay for it, so the energy comes out of its own internal energy.
Delta U equals minus W, and the gas cools.
Watch the thermometer fall, and see the curve drop more steeply than the isothermal.
